newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka surges on buoyant Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka surges on buoyant Latvian bourse.

text.p: Leading stock Unibanka soared 24 santimes to 2.35 lats and other stocks made healthy gains on a buoyant Latvian stock market on Thursday.
Market turnover came to 85,606 lats, of which Unibanka accounted for 25,788 lats. Demand for Unibanka far outstripped supply, coming in at 246,224 shares versus supply of 74,585.
The other share on the official list, Riga Transport Fleet, made a more modest gain, rising to 99 santimes from 96 on a turnover of 10,458 lats.
Fish cannery Kaija, yeast plant Rigas Raugs and the Mangali Shipyard were strong performers on the secondary list.
Kaija turned over 36,124 lats and rose to 1.46 lats after 1.27 lats while Rigas Raugs also rose from 1.27 lats to 1.46, on a lower volume of 2,004 lats.
The Mangali Shipyard concern gained, adding five santimes to 52 on a trade of 5,600 lats.
The LMR agricultural machinery plant gained to 18 santimes from 16 santimes on turnover of 4,944 lats.
